Guangze County Hos⁃pital，Nanping 354100，China）ABSTRACT：OBJECTIVE The effect of proton pump inhibitors on voriconazole valley concentration in patients with pulmonary fungal infection was studied retrospectively. METHODS Information was collected from patients treated with voriconazole at Izumi between June 2022 and December 2023. The general data，proton pump inhibitor administration schedule，voriconazole administration schedule，other drug regimens with interaction and voriconazole treatment monitoring data were summarized. According to the combination of voriconazole and proton pump inhibitor， they were divided into voriconazole monotherapy group and voriconazole combined proton pump inhibitor group. The difference of voriconazole valley concentration between the two groups and the influencing factors of voriconazole valley concentration were analyzed. RESULTS Comparing the voriconazole valley concentration between the two groups，the median voriconazole valley concentration in the combination group was slightly higher than that in the monotherapy group，but there was no statistical difference between the two groups. By stratified analysis of the types of proton pump inhibitors，it was found that the median voriconazole valley concentration in omeprazole group was higher than that in rabeprazole group when omeprazole，rabeprazole and voriconazole were combined. Meanwhile，the proportion of subtherapeutic concentration in the combined drug group was lower than that in the single drug group. CONCLUSION Proton pump inhibitors can increase voriconazole valley concentration to some extent.肺部侵袭性真菌病的主要致病菌为曲霉菌对于免疫功能低下的个体而言，此类疾病的死亡率相对较高〔1〕。
